CA.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation relation linking to identified content.

COD.rationale: Contents (color/location entries) are presented alongside separate origin/representation metadata, providing explicit content, organization/access and status differentiation for the same referents.

A.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation relation tied to content organization/access; operational labels (candidate/current/command_estimate) alone do not satisfy A.

C.rationale: Multiple explicit content entries name color-coded contents with exact coordinate sets.

D.rationale: Origin/representation metadata are presented separately from coordinate content, differentiating identification from organization/status.

O.rationale: Explicit origin and inheritance fields describe how contents are represented, presented or accessed (current vs candidate; inherited origin vs command_estimate).
